_about: Reviewed inputs to `tools/gen_nodes_tsv.py`. Everything mechanical comes from
docs/node-dumps/; this file holds only the decisions a machine cannot make.
APPROVED BY OWNER 2026-09-03 (acceptance gate T-10): the 19 reviewed category
mappings and the 9 notes below, together with the 56-row removal manifest at
The five-column schema stands; no field_io column is restored.
_field_io: There is no field_io column and no policy to set. Owner decision 2026-09-02:
the generator still compares field capability across every version and reports
the changes in the manifest, but the runtime TSV does not carry it. One question,
one answer: nodes.tsv finds candidates, versions.md carries the few cross-version
capability changes worth planning around, and probe_node.py says which sockets of
this node in this mode on this Blender actually take a field.
_exclusions_note: No identifier is excluded. Frames and reroutes stay in: the skill has to place frames, and both appear in a graph read.

ShaderNodeMix.reason: Blender lists it under Math, Rotation and Vector; Math is the one that covers every data_type this node offers.

ShaderNodeMapRange.reason: Listed under Math and Vector; Math covers both float and vector data_type.

NodeFrame.reason: Not in the Add menu - added through the header. Layout is Blender's own name for the frame/reroute group in other editors.

GeometryNodeGroup.reason: Added by dropping a node group, not from the Add menu. Group matches the Input/Group submenu that holds NodeGroupInput.

GeometryNodeSimulationInput.reason: Zone pair added as one menu item; the paired nodes have no individual menu entry.

GeometryNodeRepeatInput.reason: Zone pair added as one menu item.

GeometryNodeForeachGeometryElementInput.reason: Zone pair added as one menu item.

NodeClosureInput.reason: Zone pair added as one menu item; Utilities/Closure holds only NodeEvaluateClosure.

GeometryNodeClosureInput.reason: 4.5 name of NodeClosureInput; renamed rather than removed in 5.0.

FunctionNodeInputIntVector.reason: Registered but absent from every Add menu on all four supported versions; it is a constant input like the rest of that submenu.

ShaderNodeMixRGB.reason: Legacy node kept for file compatibility; absent from the Add menu on every version.

ShaderNodeCombineRGB.reason: 4.5-only legacy node, absent from the 4.5 Add menu.

ShaderNodeSeparateRGB.reason: 4.5-only legacy node, absent from the 4.5 Add menu.

GeometryNodeConvexHull.note: Evaluates separately per instance; loose parts and components are hulled together.

GeometryNodeSetCurveHandlePositions.note: Writing one handle re-derives the opposite one and can change the handle type, so two chained writes do not give two handles.

GeometryNodeInputMeshEdgeAngle.note: Both outputs are radians and are displayed as radians, unlike the rotation-unit sockets the editor draws in degrees.

GeometryNodeSampleIndex.note: Picks one component before it picks an index, by a fixed Mesh > Point Cloud > Curve priority that no socket or property shows.

GeometryNodeJoinGeometry.note: Drops the volume component when two or more volumes are joined - zero grids out, no warning. Every other component type merges.

GeometryNodeBlurAttribute.note: Returns its input unchanged on domains with no adjacency - point-cloud points and face corners - while the field still type-checks.

GeometryNodeSetMaterial.note: Works on curves and point clouds, but they carry one material per component and no material_index, so Selection is silently ignored there.

GeometryNodeReplaceMaterial.note: Silently does nothing on curves and point clouds; only meshes carry the material_index it rewrites.

GeometryNodeCurveToMesh.note: Marks sharp edges from Vector handles on the profile only - not Free handles, not the rail, and a poly profile creates no sharp_edge attribute at all.

origin fact is one instance of it, and an evaluated read answers it directly.
GeometryNodeMeshLine origin -> same reason, same pivot.
